reason: B advances the generic oxide-removal/galvanic-feedback concept by locating initiation at phase-dependent eutectic interfaces and proposing a microstructural control with measurable wear and corrosion outcomes. Its advantage is limited because homogenization also changes phase fractions and mechanical properties, and 3.5 wt.% aqueous NaCl is not physically compatible with 600–900 °C without special pressurization, so the experiment requires redesign using a valid molten-salt or controlled-gas regime.
